SELECT AA.*, AP.`PROMPT_TITLE` AS promptTitle, AP.`PROMPT_CONTENT` AS promptContent, (SELECT AI2.INSTANCE_NAME FROM AI_INSTANCE AI2 WHERE AI2.BIZ_KEY = AA.AGENT_KEY AND AI2.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' AND (AI2.DELETED = 0 OR AI2.DELETED IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS modelName, (SELECT SE.AVATAR FROM AI_INSTANCE AI2 JOIN AI_MODEL M ON M.MODEL_KEY = AI2.MODEL_KEY AND M.ENV_CODE = AI2.ENV_CODE JOIN SYS_EXTENSION SE ON (SE.DELETED = 0 OR SE.DELETED IS NULL) AND (SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE OR SE.EXTENSION_KEY = M.EXTENSION_CODE) WHERE AI2.BIZ_KEY = AA.AGENT_KEY AND AI2.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' AND (AI2.DELETED = 0 OR AI2.DELETED IS NULL) AND (M.DELETED = 0 OR M.DELETED IS NULL) AND M.EXTENSION_CODE IS NOT NULL AND M.EXTENSION_CODE != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN SE.EXTENSION_CODE = M.EXTENSION_CODE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1) AS providerAvatar FROM `AI_AGENT` AA LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENV_CODE, PROMPT_KEY, MAX(VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM `AI_PROMPT` WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ENV_CODE, PROMPT_KEY ) LATEST_P ON LATEST_P.ENV_CODE = AA.ENV_CODE AND LATEST_P.PROMPT_KEY = AA.PROMPT_KEY LEFT JOIN `AI_PROMPT` AP ON AP.PROMPT_KEY = AA.PROMPT_KEY AND AP.ENV_CODE = AA.ENV_CODE AND AP.VERSION = LATEST_P.MAX_VERSION AND (AP.DELETED = 0 OR AP.DELETED IS NULL) WHERE (AA.DELETED = 0 OR AA.DELETED IS NULL)
AND AA.AGENT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.name}, '%')
AND AA.STATUS = #{req.status}
ORDER BY AA.CREATE_TIME DESC
